newsitem.title: USA: J.C. Penney files shelf for $2.6 bln debt.
newsitem.headline: J.C. Penney files shelf for $2.6 bln debt.

text.p: J.C. Penney Co Inc filed Friday a shelf registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up to $2.6 billion in debt securities and warrants.
When combined with a previous registration, J.C. Penney will have a total offering of $3 billion in debt securities available for sale.
Net proceeds will be used to refinance, on a long-term basis, $1.9 billion of short-term debt incurred by the company in connection with its acquisition of Eckerd Corp.
J.C. Penney, based in Plano, Texas, is a major retailer operating over 1,200 JCPenney department stores in all 50 states, Puerto Rico, Mexico and Chile.
